title: Hyperia City launches: Emerald Steel leads the early meta, and the first big Set 14 qualifiers are played
summary: Set 14, Hyperia City, came out everywhere on October 23, a week after the October 16 prereleases. It adds Coco characters and the new ink drop mechanic.
Inkdecks' first Hyperia City meta report puts Emerald Steel Evasive on top with a 23% share, followed by Amber Emerald and Amber Sapphire Princesses.
The first big Set 14 qualifiers ran on October 24: a 144-player Grand Tournoi CCQ in France won by BlingGuest, and a 79-player CCQ Infinity 5K in the US won by Darian.
Into the Inkdark is open for preorder ahead of its February 12, 2027 release. It brings the first Collector Boosters and the serialized Illustrious rarity, with only 23 copies of each card printed.
The Quest World Iconic Clash, a 16-player invitational, gave the first look at top-level Set 14 lists. Amber Emerald Songs and Emerald Amethyst Retro were the most common decks.
